name: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary

versions.label: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary

entranceAntiphon.text: The Lord said: I think thoughts of peace and not of affliction. You will call upon me, and I will answer you, and I will lead back your captives from every place.

formulary.collect: Grant us, we pray, O Lord our God, the constant gladness of being devoted to you, for it is full and lasting happiness to serve with constancy the author of all that is good. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever
formulary.prayerOverOfferings: Grant, O Lord, we pray, that what we offer in the sight of your majesty may obtain for us the grace of being devoted to you and gain us the prize of everlasting happiness. Through Christ our Lord.

communionAntiphon.text: To be near God is my happiness, to place my hope in God the Lord. Or: Mk 11: 23-24 Amen, I say to you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you will receive, and it shall be given to you, says the Lord.

formulary.prayerAfterCommunion: We have partaken of the gifts of this sacred mystery, humbly imploring, O Lord, that what your Son commanded us to do in memory of him may bring us growth in charity. Through Christ our Lord.
